description: Helps you decide what to send, and when, to open or restart a conversation. You give the persona, stage and objective (prospecting, nurture, follow up or re engagement), plus your solution, the pain point, value proposition, proof and ask. You get each email with its subject, send day and body, and a note on what you did not give. No placeholder is left in a body, and no result or statistic is invented.

num_emails.description: Accepted but not used yet: each sequence type has a fixed number of emails

sender_context.description: Context about sender (role, shared connections, etc.)

sequence_type.description: Type of email sequence. cold_outreach, warm_follow_up, post_demo and re_engagement have their own templates; the other types return a general outline

social_proof.description: Customer names, stats, or proof points

target_persona.description: Target persona (e.g., VP Sales, CTO, CFO)

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.

name: email_sequence_generator
title: Email Sequence Generator
